rules.statement: A party who has a registered Attorney must have that Attorney sign any necessary documents, such as the Notice of Appeal and Petition of Appeal, unless the party revokes the proxy in accordance with Section 27(2) of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore, as long as this proxy remains valid, it is only the registered Attorney who is authorised to act on behalf of the party in presenting and prosecuting the appeal. The authority flows from the appointment given by the Appellant herself."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 27(2) of the Civil Procedure Code
